Product Overview

This listing features a state-of-the-art brine-mist fogponic rack, meticulously engineered for superior hydroponic cultivation. With a generous growing area of 32.1 square metres, this system delivers ample space for high-density plant growth, setting it apart from conventional options.

Technical Specifications

  • Root Zone Temperature: The system maintains an optimal root zone temperature of 22 degrees Celsius, ensuring ideal conditions for robust root health and accelerated plant development.
  • Plant Capacity: Equipped with 56 dedicated plant slots, it accommodates significant crop volumes, maximizing your yield per cycle.
  • Growth Cycle: The recommended cycle spans 179 days, a carefully determined period that aligns with best practices for maximum productivity and plant health.
  • Irrigation Mode: Utilizing a passive capillary irrigation system, this rack minimizes maintenance while delivering consistent moisture, outperforming active systems in reliability and efficiency.
